title: From Description to Score: Can LLMs Quantify Vulnerabilities?

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model classification performance on highly imbalanced CVSS metric datasets using confusion matrices, weighted precision, recall, and F1-scores to measure the tendency of models to over-predict majority classes (e.g., predicting NETWORK over LOCAL).

Prompting the LLM (GPT-4o) to explain its own misclassifications for a small sample of CVEs to identify if the model overgeneralizes from similar past training examples and applies incorrect heuristics.
